about.description: Gold perpetual market. The contract tracks the price of one troy ounce of gold. Users get linear exposure to gold price moves without owning bullion, vaulted metal, or redeemable claims on physical inventory, with pricing referencing an external spot gold feed. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDT. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the cash namespace, but are operated by Dreamcash rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
